Awesome Comics.subject: Environment & Ecology
Awesome Comics.question: The _____ was American comic book studio.
Awesome Comics.fact: Awesome Comics or Awesome Entertainment (also called Awesome-Hyperwerks when briefly joined with Hyperwerks Entertainment) was an American comic book studio formed in 1997 by Rob Liefeld following his expulsion from Image Comics, a company he co-founded five years prior.
